docs.title: About this book
docs.text:
The Pāli chronicle of Ceylon from the Buddha’s visits to the reign of Mahāsena, with the story of Aśoka’s mission, in Geiger’s English translation (London, 1912). Listed in the catalogue of the Rare Book Society of India.

From Internet Archive · Public domain in India

Scanned from a copy in the University of California Libraries; hosted by the Internet Archive. Item: Mahavamsa : the great chronicle of Ceylon · Geiger, Wilhelm, 1856-1943, Bode, Mabel Haynes · 1912, 380 scanned pages. Published 1912; Wilhelm Geiger died 1943 and Mabel Haynes Bode 1922; the chronicle is ancient; public domain in India.

This book is not stored in this library: its pages are shown from the Internet Archive when they are opened, in this library's own viewer, and each chapter ends with this credit. The text of each page is the machine-read (OCR) text of the scan, lightly cleaned; the scan of every page is one button away. The item on the Internet Archive (opened only if you click it).
